ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels. High-intensity pixels are concentrated on the distal margins, while low-intensity pixels dominate the central and basal areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous high-intensity white blobs located on the lateral extremities of both the left and right lobes. These white regions exhibit irregular, speckled interior boundaries transitioning into a solid low-intensity black central region spanning the median notch to the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary. Peaks are more pronounced and jagged on the outer thirds of each lobe, becoming smaller and more rounded towards the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep on the distal edges, transitioning to a slight concavity approaching the median notch, forming a complex non-linear curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, three-dimensional white circular protrusions (barnacles) concentrated heavily on the distal tips. Several circular, faint 'cookie-cutter' style scars are visible on the mid-left and mid-right lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four horizontal, parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe, cutting through the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the trailing edge tips. Distinctive dark 'island' spots of pigmentation are present within the white patch on the right lobe distal area.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical ridge-line mapping visible extending from the peduncle through the center of the fluke surface.
